questions.q: I love ____ basketball with my friends at the weekend.
questions.why: Love fiilinden sonra gelen eylem -ing takısı alır.

questions.q: My best friend hates ____ in the morning.
questions.why: Hate fiilinden sonra gelen eylem -ing takısı alır.

questions.q: Do you enjoy ____ to pop music?
questions.why: Enjoy fiilinden sonra gelen eylem -ing takısı alır.

questions.q: We don't like ____ horror films.
questions.why: Like/don't like yapısından sonra fiile -ing eklenir.

questions.q: Does she like ____ Turkish food?
questions.why: Soru cümlelerinde de like + -ing kuralı değişmez.

questions.q: I ____ going to the cinema alone.
questions.why: Geniş zamanda 'I' öznesi ile olumsuzluk 'don't' ile yapılır.

questions.q: They enjoy ____ in the sea in summer.
questions.why: Swim fiili -ing alırken sondaki sessiz harf çift yazılır: swimming.

questions.q: My father ____ reading the newspaper every day.
questions.why: He/she/it özneleriyle geniş zamanda fiile -s takısı gelir: likes.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: I hate to washing the dishes.
questions.why: Hate + fiil-ing yapısı dilbilgisi açısından doğrudur.

questions.q: We love ____ time together.
questions.why: Love fiilinden sonra gelen eylem -ing takısı alır.

reading.title: My Best Friend
reading.text: My best friend's name is Mert. We are colleagues in an office in Ankara. We spend a lot of time together after work. We both love doing sports. On Saturdays, we enjoy running in the park. Mert likes playing football, but I hate playing it because I am not very good at it. We also like going to the cinema. Mert loves watching action movies, but I prefer comedies. We don't like staying at home at the weekend. We enjoy meeting new people and talking about our hobbies. It is great to have a good friend.

o: The hobbies and activities of two friends
The best cinema in the city
questions.why: Metin genel olarak iki arkadaşın birlikte neler yapmaktan hoşlandığını anlatmaktadır.

writing.prompt: Arkadaşlarınızla yapmayı sevdiğiniz ve sevmediğiniz aktiviteleri yazın. 'like', 'love' ve 'hate' fiillerini -ing takısı ile kullanın.
writing.prompt_en: Write about the activities you like and hate doing with your friends. Use 'like', 'love' and 'hate' with the -ing form.
writing.model: I have two close friends, Can and Elif. We love spending time in Kadıköy. We like drinking coffee and talking. Can and I love playing video games, but Elif hates playing them. She likes listening to music. At the weekend, we enjoy walking by the sea. We don't like staying at home because it is boring.
